origin.description: Assistant synthesis of the user-directed recovered vision; implementation and economic advantage require separate evidence.
Historical proposal supporting this meaning; not automatic authority.
The user explicitly requires architectural choices, rejected options and reasons to survive, and requests useful harness practices be assimilated without flattening Projector into instructions.
Motivating integration evidence; not authority for Projector-specific design or claimed implementation.

payload.statement: After arbitrary repository edits, compare current observations with retained bindings, predicted impact and applicable lens obligations. Report stale reasoning separately from actual architectural violations. Accept alternate conforming implementations. Surface unexpected consumers, changed membership, violated assumptions and observed impact beyond the plan. Retain Planning Surprises and candidate relationships as state-bound derived evidence with a concrete repair route; explicit acceptance is required before inferred relationships become authoritative. Successful controlled changes authenticate their post-observation evidence; host edits do not acquire a controlled-execution certificate.
payload.title: Reconcile changes made outside Projector
